name: OD6 Metals Limited
summary: OD6 Metals Limited is a mineral exploration company mainly seeking rare earth element deposits. It fully owns two Western Australian projects: Splinter Rock, six exploration licenses over 2,579 square kilometers northeast of Esperance, and Grass Patch, four licenses over 2,248 square kilometers north of Esperance. Established in 2021, it is headquartered in West Perth.
